title: Armored asymmetric dress
prompt:
Create ONE original photorealistic full-body wardrobe concept for upgraded Riley Brooks in the attached reference. Single vertical 2:3 image, head to boots fully visible with generous margins, one person, relaxed upright standing pose, hands at her sides, face toward camera, clean graphite studio backdrop and floor. This is a low-cost costume-development option for an energetic premium sci-fi advertisement.

Preserve the attached selected portrait's exact recognizable face, slim adult build, brunette bob with teal accent, natural brown eye on viewer LEFT and luminous cyan cybernetic eye on viewer RIGHT. Preserve the asymmetric satin-titanium face/jaw hardware on her anatomical LEFT (viewer RIGHT) and the substantial dark mechanical neck with magenta and cyan accents. Keep the natural skin and facial proportions, not a new identity. Do not mirror the character or redesign the selected implants.

The user explicitly wants a new post-upgrade wardrobe instead of conventional office attire. Replace the white shirt, pencil skirt, burgundy badge/lanyard and shoulder handbag completely. Dress her for superhuman running, reflexes and strength: a coherent fashion-forward cyberpunk outfit with visible high-quality material construction, flexible joints and grounded sprint-capable boots. The neck hardware remains clearly exposed and integrated with the garment neckline. Use graphite, black and satin titanium with selective cyan/magenta accents that echo her implants. Elegant athletic proportions, realistic fabric folds and metal reflections, not a bulky combat robot. Both hands have believable five-finger anatomy. Outfit fully covers the torso; editorial confidence without a pin-up pose.

Neutral studio key light makes all garment details readable, restrained cyan/magenta edge lights, crisp realistic photography. No weapons, helmet, sunglasses, shopping bag, office badge, logos, captions, UI or collage. Keep the complete outfit and both shoes in frame.

WARDROBE DIRECTION: A distinct futuristic graphite asymmetric dress with structured short shoulder pieces, a fitted but practical waist and an angled knee-length segmented skirt. Two overlapping flexible skirt panels and generous walking/stride vents over opaque fitted technical leggings allow unrestricted running. Small satin-titanium plates and cyan/magenta inset edges integrate the bodice and hip panels with her mechanical neck. Sleek calf-high flat-soled technical boots. Strong fashion silhouette with obvious original cyberpunk construction, not an office pencil dress or a restrictive evening gown.
notes: User selected Riley concept 3 and requested a post-upgrade outfit replacing conventional office clothes.
Selected rendered implant side and eye design are preserved as the target; new costume proposals await user choice.
Prior office wardrobe remains intact for pre-upgrade opening.

observations: Visually inspected full-body original: one person, entire outfit and both shoes visible.
Broad face/hair and anatomical-left (viewer-right) facial hardware placement retained, but mechanical geometry is simplified and the selected portrait cyan eye glow is weakened.
Costume candidate only; selected Riley portrait remains the face/cyberware target for refinement. User wardrobe selection and production identity review pending.
Asymmetric overlapping dress, opaque leggings and tall boots are readable. Freedom of stride remains untested in motion.

user_feedback: First wardrobe batch covers too much of the body and lacks chrome arms and legs. Wardrobe 3 looks fine but not great: revise rather than finalize.
